[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":129,"var":"data/size","code":"flb_parser_do(fuzz_parser, (char*)data, size, &out_buf, &out_size, &out_time);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are passed as the parser input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":279,"var":"conn->buf","code":"recv_len = receiver_to_unpacker(conn, EACH_RECV_SIZE, unp);","note":"The forward protocol parser reads attacker-controlled network bytes from the connection buffer into msgpack unpacking state."},
  {"step":3,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":296,"var":"result.data","code":"ret = msgpack_unpacker_next_with_size(unp, &result, &bytes);","note":"The unpacker decodes the attacker bytes into a msgpack root object for further dispatch."},
  {"step":4,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":304,"var":"root","code":"root = result.data;","note":"The decoded msgpack object becomes the root value used by the protocol parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":331,"var":"entry","code":"entry = root.via.array.ptr[1];","note":"The second array element is selected as the payload; its type controls which branch processes the input."},
  {"step":6,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":459,"var":"data/len","code":"data = entry.via.str.ptr; len = entry.via.str.size;","note":"In the packed-forward branch, the attacker-controlled string/bin payload pointer and length are extracted directly from msgpack."},
  {"step":7,"file":"plugins/in_forward/fw_prot.c","function":"fw_prot_parser","line":470,"var":"gz_data/gz_size","code":"ret = flb_gzip_uncompress((void *) data, len, &gz_data, &gz_size);","note":"If the compressed option is enabled, the payload is treated as gzip data and decompressed into a new heap buffer."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/flb_gzip.c","function":"flb_gzip_uncompress","line":160,"var":"in_data/in_len","code":"int flb_gzip_uncompress(void *in_data, size_t in_len, void **out_data, size_t *out_len)","note":"The decompressor consumes the attacker-controlled gzip bytes and validates only the gzip framing before inflating."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/flb_gzip.c","function":"flb_gzip_uncompress","line":214,"var":"start/zip_data","code":"zip_data = (void *) start; zip_len = in_len - (start - p);","note":"The compressed payload pointer is advanced past the header, leaving the remaining attacker bytes as the deflate stream."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/flb_gzip.c","function":"flb_gzip_uncompress","line":223,"var":"out_buf","code":"out_buf = flb_malloc(out_size);","note":"A heap buffer is allocated for the decompressed output, sized from the gzip metadata and stream state."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/flb_gzip.c","function":"flb_gzip_uncompress","line":236,"var":"stream.next_in","code":"stream.next_in = zip_data; stream.avail_in = zip_len;","note":"The inflater is pointed at the attacker-controlled compressed stream bytes."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/flb_gzip.c","function":"flb_gzip_uncompress","line":241,"var":"out_buf contents","code":"status = inflate(&stream, Z_FINISH);","note":"Inflation reads from the attacker stream and writes the decompressed result into the heap buffer; malformed lengths or crafted stream structure can drive the read past the intended end and trigger the reported heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
